subScenes.name: 迟到道歉
subScenes.description: 朋友因交通堵塞迟到，向约好的同伴真诚道歉。

qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友/同事因你迟到而询问原因，你需要道歉并解释

followUps.text: I'm so sorry! My alarm didn't go off, and I overslept.
followUps.text_cn: 太抱歉了！我的闹钟没响，我睡过头了。

followUps.text: My bad—I got stuck in traffic and couldn't get here any faster.
followUps.text_cn: 是我的错，我堵车了，实在没法更快了。

followUps.text: Sorry about that! Can I buy you coffee to make up for it?
followUps.text_cn: 对不起！我请你喝杯咖啡补偿一下好吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友或同事因你迟到而询问时的自然回应，避免找借口，体现责任感和礼貌

qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你又迟到了，到底怎么回事？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方因你多次迟到而表达不满，需回应以缓和关系

followUps.text: You're right—I've been late too often. I'm working on being more punctual.
followUps.text_cn: 你说得对，我确实迟到了太多次，我正在努力改掉这个习惯。

followUps.text: I know it's frustrating—I’ve set three alarms now and I won’t let it happen again.
followUps.text_cn: 我知道这很烦人，我现在设了三个闹钟，绝不会再发生了。

followUps.text: I really hate letting people down—I’ll make sure to leave earlier next time.
followUps.text_cn: 我真的讨厌让人失望，下次我会提前出发。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于对方情绪较强烈时，回应需体现反思与诚意，避免防御性语言

qaPairs.triggerText: Did you forget we were meeting?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你是不是忘了我们约好了？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 对方怀疑你并非因意外迟到，而是忘记约定，需澄清意图

followUps.text: No way—I had it on my calendar! I just got caught up in an urgent call.
followUps.text_cn: 怎么可能！我日历上记着呢！只是被一个紧急电话耽搁了。

followUps.text: I’m really sorry—I did forget to check my calendar this morning.
followUps.text_cn: 真的很抱歉，今天早上我忘了看日历。

followUps.text: I didn’t forget—I just thought we were meeting at 3, not 2:30. My bad!
followUps.text_cn: 我没忘，我只是以为我们约的是3点，不是2:30。是我的错！

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于对方质疑你是否故意忽视约定，回应需澄清误会或承认错误，避免激化矛盾

subScenes.name: 说明原因
subScenes.description: 清晰解释迟到的具体原因，避免显得推卸责任。

qaPairs.triggerText: Hey, sorry I missed your call yesterday — everything okay?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嘿，抱歉昨天没接到你电话——没事吧？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友因错过电话而道歉，你需要解释原因

followUps.text: I'm so sorry! My phone died during a meeting and I didn't have a charger.
followUps.text_cn: 真的很抱歉！开会时手机没电了，我也没带充电器。

followUps.text: My bad — I was in the hospital with my mom and couldn't check my phone.
followUps.text_cn: 对不起，我那天在医院陪妈妈，没空看手机。

followUps.text: Sorry about that — I was offline all day hiking and didn't have signal.
followUps.text_cn: 不好意思，我一整天去徒步了，没信号。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于向朋友或同事解释错过联系的原因，语气真诚但简洁，避免过度辩解

qaPairs.triggerText: You didn't show up to the group lunch — what happened?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你没来团体午餐——出什么事了？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事因缺席聚餐被询问，需说明原因

followUps.text: I totally forgot — my calendar glitched and I didn't get the reminder.
followUps.text_cn: 我完全忘了，日历出错没提醒我。

followUps.text: I had a sudden migraine and couldn't leave the house — hope you all had fun!
followUps.text_cn: 我突然偏头痛，没法出门——希望你们玩得开心！

followUps.text: I was stuck in traffic for two hours — I texted but maybe you didn't see it.
followUps.text_cn: 我堵车堵了两小时，发了消息但可能你们没看到。

qaPairs.usageNote: 解释缺席社交活动的原因，需体现责任感与对他人感受的体谅

qaPairs.triggerText: You were late again — is something going on?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 你又迟到了——是不是有什么事？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事对频繁迟到表示关切，需诚恳解释

followUps.text: You're right — I've been struggling with my commute since I moved. I'm working on it.
followUps.text_cn: 你说得对，我搬家后通勤一直很糟，我正在想办法解决。

followUps.text: I know I've been late — I'm trying to leave earlier, but my alarm keeps failing.
followUps.text_cn: 我知道我迟到了，我正努力早点走，但闹钟总出问题。

followUps.text: I'm really sorry — I've been overworked and losing track of time. I'll set better reminders.
followUps.text_cn: 真的很抱歉，我最近太忙了，总忘记时间，我会设更好的提醒。

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于回应反复迟到的质询，需展现自我觉察与改进意愿，避免推卸责任

subScenes.name: 表达愧疚
subScenes.description: 用语气和措辞传达真诚的歉意，安抚对方情绪。

qaPairs.triggerText: I know you didn't mean it, but I was really counting on you for the presentation.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我知道你不是故意的，但我本来很依赖你来负责这个演示的。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友/同事因你未履行承诺而感到失望，你需要表达愧疚

followUps.text: You're totally right—I let you down, and I'm really sorry. Can I help you redo it this afternoon?
followUps.text_cn: 你说得对，我让你失望了，真的很抱歉。我下午能帮你重做吗？

followUps.text: I feel awful about this—I should've told you sooner I was swamped. I owe you one.
followUps.text_cn: 我对此感到非常愧疚，我早该告诉你我最近太忙了。我欠你一个人情。

followUps.text: I never meant to stress you out—I’ll make it up to you, maybe dinner this weekend?
followUps.text_cn: 我从没想让你烦心，我一定补偿你，这周末请你吃饭？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于朋友或同事因你未履约而表达失望时，回应需体现真诚、责任感和修复意愿，避免敷衍

qaPairs.triggerText: Hey, you forgot to text me about the meetup last night—I was waiting for hours.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 嘿，你昨晚根本没发消息告诉我聚会的事，我等了几个小时。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友因你失联而感到被忽视，你需要表达愧疚

followUps.text: I'm so sorry—I got caught up in an emergency call and my phone died. I should've left a note.
followUps.text_cn: 太抱歉了，我接到一个紧急电话，手机没电了。我本该留个便条的。

followUps.text: You're right—I’ve been flaky lately and it’s not fair to you. I’m working on being more reliable.
followUps.text_cn: 你说得对，我最近确实太不靠谱了，对你不公平。我正在努力变得更可靠。

followUps.text: I feel terrible—I know how much you value punctuality. Can I take you out to coffee tomorrow as an apology?
followUps.text_cn: 我真的很内疚，我知道你特别看重守时。明天请你喝咖啡赔罪好吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于因疏忽导致他人等待或被冷落的社交道歉，回应需避免借口化，强调共情与行动

qaPairs.triggerText: I noticed you didn't show up to the group study—I thought we were all in this together.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我注意到你没来小组学习，我以为我们是一起努力的。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事/同学因你缺席集体活动而感到被背叛，你需要表达愧疚

followUps.text: I let the team down—I had a family emergency, but that’s no excuse. I’ll catch up on the notes and help next week.
followUps.text_cn: 我让团队失望了，我有家庭急事，但这不是借口。我会补上笔记，下周帮忙。

followUps.text: You're right—I shouldn't have just disappeared. I thought one absence wouldn't matter, but I see now it does.
followUps.text_cn: 你说得对，我不该就这样消失。我以为少一次没关系，但现在明白了这很重要。

followUps.text: I’m really sorry—I didn’t realize how much it affected the group. Can I organize the next session to make it up?
followUps.text_cn: 真的很抱歉，我没意识到这会对团队造成这么大影响。我能组织下一次学习来弥补吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于团队协作场景中的缺席道歉，回应需体现对集体责任的认知，避免个人中心化解释

subScenes.name: 提出补偿
subScenes.description: 主动提议请喝咖啡或改期，弥补对方的时间损失。

qaPairs.triggerText: What can I do to make it up to you?
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友/同事道歉并主动提出补偿，学习者回应补偿提议

followUps.text: Thanks, just buy me coffee next time!
followUps.text_cn: 谢谢，下次请我喝杯咖啡就好！

followUps.text: Actually, I’d rather you just be on time next time.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我更希望你下次能准时。

followUps.text: How about helping me with the presentation this weekend?
followUps.text_cn: 要不你帮我做这个周末的演示？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友或同事道歉后，自然回应补偿提议，体现不同态度和关系亲密度

qaPairs.triggerText: I feel bad about missing your birthday — let me make it right.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我错过了你的生日，真的很抱歉，让我弥补一下。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友为错过重要事件道歉并提出补偿，学习者回应

followUps.text: That’s so sweet — dinner on me next time?
followUps.text_cn: 太贴心了！那下次我请吃饭？

followUps.text: It’s okay, I know you didn’t mean it. No need to do anything.
followUps.text_cn: 没关系，我知道你不是故意的，不用补偿了。

followUps.text: Could we plan a small get-together this month instead?
followUps.text_cn: 我们这个月能约个小聚会吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于非正式社交场合中对错过重要事件的道歉回应，强调情感修复而非物质补偿

qaPairs.triggerText: I messed up the project deadline — what would help you feel better?
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我搞砸了项目截止日期，怎样做能让你感觉好一点？
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事因工作失误道歉并询问如何补偿，学习者回应

followUps.text: Just cover the extra hours I’ll need to fix it — I’ll send you the list.
followUps.text_cn: 你帮我多干点活来补上吧，我发你具体清单。

followUps.text: I’m frustrated, but I don’t want you to burn out — let’s just fix it together.
followUps.text_cn: 我很沮丧，但我不想你累垮，我们一起解决吧。

followUps.text: Can you take over my next client call? I need to recharge.
followUps.text_cn: 你能替我去开下个客户电话会吗？我需要喘口气。

qaPairs.usageNote: 适用于职场同事间因工作失误的补偿对话，体现专业性与边界感

subScenes.name: 化解尴尬
subScenes.description: 用轻松话语缓和气氛，重建轻松友好的互动氛围。

qaPairs.triggerText: Sorry, I didn’t mean to interrupt you.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 抱歉，我不是故意打断你的。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友无意打断你说话，主动道歉以化解尴尬

followUps.text: No worries, I was just pausing anyway.
followUps.text_cn: 没关系，我本来也正要停一下。

followUps.text: Actually, I appreciate you jumping in—I was stuck.
followUps.text_cn: 其实我很感谢你插话，我正卡住了。

followUps.text: It’s fine, but next time maybe give me a little signal?
followUps.text_cn: 没事，不过下次能先给我个暗示吗？

qaPairs.usageNote: 用于朋友或同事无意造成尴尬时，自然回应对方的道歉，体现社交弹性

qaPairs.triggerText: Oops, I spilled coffee on your notes—so sorry!
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 哎呀，我把咖啡洒在你的笔记上了，真对不起！
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 同事不小心弄脏你的工作资料，当场道歉

followUps.text: It’s okay, I had a backup on my phone anyway.
followUps.text_cn: 没事，我手机里有备份。

followUps.text: Ugh, those were my only notes… but thanks for offering to buy me coffee.
followUps.text_cn: 天啊，那是我仅有的笔记……但谢谢你提出请我喝咖啡。

followUps.text: Don’t stress—I’ll scan them later. Let’s just grab lunch instead?
followUps.text_cn: 别担心，我待会儿扫描一下。不如我们去吃午饭？

qaPairs.usageNote: 应对工作场合中意外造成的轻微损失，回应需平衡情绪与社交修复

qaPairs.triggerText: I know I was late again—I really suck at being on time.
qaPairs.triggerTextCn: 我知道我又迟到了，我真的不擅长守时。
qaPairs.scenarioHintCn: 朋友自责迟到，用自我贬低方式表达歉意

followUps.text: Hey, we all have our quirks—I’m the one who forgets birthdays!
followUps.text_cn: 嘿，每个人都有小毛病，我可是连生日都忘的人！

followUps.text: It’s fine, but can we try setting a reminder next time?
followUps.text_cn: 没关系，但下次能设个提醒吗？

followUps.text: I get it—you’ve been swamped. Let’s just meet 10 minutes later next time?
followUps.text_cn: 我懂，你最近太忙了。下次我们改到晚10分钟见面？

qaPairs.usageNote: 当对方用自我批评表达歉意时，回应应避免强化负面自我认知，转为共情或建设性方案
